source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: A Healthier You: Based on the Dietary Guidelines for Americans, US Department of Health and Human Services, Office of Disease Prevention and Health Promotion

steps.instruction: Cut 1 pound of lean beef into 1-inch cubes.
Heat 1 teaspoon of oil in a non-stick skillet.
Add 3/4 tablespoon of finely chopped onion.
steps.spoken: Add the onion and sauté for 2 minutes.
Add the beef and sauté for 5 more minutes, turning it to brown evenly.

steps.instruction: Remove the beef from the pan and keep it hot.
Add the remaining 1 teaspoon of oil to the pan.
Sauté 1 pound of sliced mushrooms in the pan.
Add the beef and onions back to the pan.
Add 1/4 teaspoon salt, 1 dash black pepper and 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg.
Gently stir in 1/4 cup beef broth and 1 cup plain yogurt.
Heat gently, but do not boil.
steps.spoken: Heat the pan gently, but do not let it boil.

steps.instruction: Serve with 6 cups of cooked macaroni.
